speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I can see you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms. To understand the underlying cause, have you noticed any specific triggers, such as contact with plants, chemicals, or certain foods? REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Skin_Biopsy: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the biopsy results; the presence of chronic inflammatory cells suggestive of leprosy is a critical finding. To confirm the specific type of leprosy and assess nerve involvement, do you recall if you have experienced any loss of sensation or color changes in your fingers or toes? REQUEST TEST: Purely_Electrical_Nerve_Conduction_Study; REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_biopsy_close_up

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Purely_Electrical_Nerve_Conduction_Study: Reduced sensory nerve action potentials in the ulnar nerves.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lepromatous Leprosy (Hansen's Disease). The biopsy showing chronic inflammation, combined with reduced sensory nerve action potentials in the ulnar nerves and your history of pruritic rash, confirms this diagnosis. I will now prescribe appropriate multibacter chemotherapy and recommend you begin treatment immediately.
